intro: The UAE is a federation of seven monarchies, each ruled by a royal family.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The seven rulers form the Federal Supreme Council, which chooses the president, by tradition the ruler of Abu Dhabi. The ruler of Dubai is usually vice president and prime minister.
The Federal National Council advises the government; half its members are elected by a limited group of citizens.

chapters.title: Seven emirates
text: They are Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah. Each manages much of its own affairs.

keyTerms.meaning: Rule by a monarch without elected limits.
